**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §7.1 (`R-2.11.1⁰ᵇ`, C0/Stage-1 slice)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/030_S1.26__attended-cli.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.11.1⁰ᵇ**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.25` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all verification is the `cargo` suites)

## Summary

`hh-cli` is now a real attended CLI — and it is *thin*: every command is
argv → typed `hh-embed/1` records → one boundary-operation sequence →
rendered results/prompts/ledger projections. The crate's only contract
dependency is the generated client (`hh-embed-client-generated`); the
same `Boundary` trait drives both the in-process test binding
(`ServiceBoundary` over `EmbedService`) and a spawned `hh-kernel serve`
(`ProcessBoundary`, piped stdio + typed `hello` — never an in-process
fallback). The CLI decides no kernel semantics, widens no authority,
recomputes no identity, keeps no independent state.

### `hh-cli` (new persistent crate)
- **Command surface** — `version`, `doctor`, `run start|events|status|
  inspect|resume|fork|cancel|amend|submit`, `approval list|show|
  respond`; unknown commands/flags are typed `invocation_error`.
- **Attended loop** — durable `read` pages from watermark 0,
  `upcall.request_permission` polling, `respond_permission` answers;
  open-time asks are answered *before* `submit`; EOF on a prompt parks
  the run honestly (the ask stays `pending`, the session detaches, the
  run stays resumable).
- **Approval rendering** — permission id, proposal, rendering text,
  `explanation{rule_id, risk_factors, what_would_auto_approve,
  model_justification}` (justification labelled as delegate-authority
  content), offered option ids only — never invented.
- **Attendance + stdin typing** — `interactive` requires a TTY;
  positional prompt = principal input; piped stdin = a separate
  `external/import` context item; conflicts are pre-ledger
  `invocation_error`s.
- **Exhaustion `escalate`/`stop`** — unattended → `budget_exhausted`;
  interactive `escalate` → attended `amend{budget}` wakes the run
  (I-1 widening gate enforced kernel-side).
- **Full §2.5 `ExitClass` sum** — all eleven classes with the total
  `outcome_class × StopReason` derivation; interim numerals 64–73
  (ADR-0210/OQ-384 band); `result.exit_class` is authoritative.
- **InvocationRecord + idempotency** — one `lifecycle.surface.invoked`
  provenance row per command (the AC-2 documented carve-out);
  per-invocation per-step idempotency keys; `open_session` replay is
  verbatim on a live session, a fresh attach on a dead `new`.

### Boundary/kernel changes the CLI forced
- `hh-embed`: idempotent `open_session` replay honest about session
  lifetime; live-session cap counting with same-run exclusion;
  `amend` (`budget` target, I-1 gate, others `stage_pending`) and `fork`
  implemented at `experimental` tier; `AmendParams.invocation` and the
  `AuthorityWideningRequiresHuman` (1306) error in the schema;
  explanation members propagated through `upcall.request_permission`;
  deterministic `EmbedService::open_with` for acceptance fixtures;
  `overrides.rs` refuses schema-invisible literal overrides as
  `AuthorityViolation`.
- `hh-ledger`: `read{from_seq > head}` → empty page (aligns with
  `stream_events`); **`release_silent`** — a sealed run's writer-lease
  release no longer mints a post-`run.finished` row, preserving
  AC-3's stream ≡ export byte-identity.
- `hh-control`: escalate-aware exhaustion (`escalate_on_exhaustion`,
  the escalate-proposal carve-out fixing the infinite re-trip),
  structured `StopReason` through `stop{…}`, `lifecycle.budget.
  exceeded`, cancelled-stop admit.
- `hh-hir`: `budget_dir` scalar-leaf compare so ceiling edits classify.
